seedText: We moved a hot path off our TypeScript monolith to a small Go service and p99 latency dropped from 800ms to 90ms.

seedText: I failed my first two coding interviews and only started passing once I began explaining my thought process out loud while solving.
We doubled our price and churn went DOWN. Cheap customers were the loudest and least happy.
The best productivity change I made was deleting Slack from my phone, not adding another app.
